title: Use Jev in Claude Code hooks and loops
description: Build a reviewable Jev gate for Claude Code hooks, then consider stop checks and issue triage. Includes failure paths and a careful reading of the cost claims.

source.title: Loop Engineering Meets Jev Engineering: How to Cut Your Claude Bill From $765 to $3 a Month

connections.step: Explore a Claude Code PreToolUse gate and Stop check with offline fixtures
connections.why: Its Python hooks make TypeSafe Jev judgments at tool and stop events, directly matching two of the article's implementation steps. The Stop hook is log-only by default.
connections.limitations: MIT Python 3.10+ source and Claude Code install scripts. Live hooks require a TypeSafe key, send selected tool arguments, output and transcript evidence to TypeSafe, and incur provider charges. Missing-key behavior is no-op; the Stop check is not an enforcing gate by default. Catalog cassette replays are not a live Claude Code or TypeSafe evaluation. Buzzoni did not mention or endorse this repository.

connections.step: Classify GitHub issues before deciding which work merits an agent run
connections.why: The Python classifier asks typed Jev questions and uses code-owned write guards for issue labels, corresponding to the article's trigger stage. It does not launch Claude Code or open PRs.
connections.limitations: MIT Python 3.10+ package. A TypeSafe key and separate inference charges are needed for live classification; issue text leaves the host. GitHub label writes additionally need a token and opt-in --apply. Catalog tests were offline; no live GitHub or TypeSafe run is claimed. Buzzoni did not mention or endorse it.

faqs.question: Can a Jev hook replace Claude Code permissions?
faqs.answer: No. A PreToolUse command hook can add an allow, deny or ask judgment, but a hook timeout does not block the tool call. Keep Claude Code permissions, deterministic deny rules and human approval for consequential actions.

faqs.question: Does Jev cut a Claude Code bill from $765 to $3?
faqs.answer: Those are the article's modeled monthly prices for 600 assumed small decisions per night, not measured bills. They exclude Claude's coding turns, hook maintenance, retries and other work; measure real token usage and cache behavior before claiming savings.

faqs.question: Should a Stop hook trust a high Jev score?
faqs.answer: Only after exact checks pass and the evidence covers the goal. A high Noul value is not proof of completion; keep a continuation limit, expose unresolved work for review and evaluate mistakes on representative tasks.

faqs.question: How should a Jev issue trigger handle uncertain or failed answers?
faqs.answer: Leave the issue in a human review queue. A missing, low-confidence, malformed or timed-out answer should not launch an unattended coding run or change labels silently. Limit input size, requests and agent runs separately.
